title.zh: 选型与量测：退火结果必须用器件指标闭环
title.en: Selection and metrology: close the annealing loop with device metrics

subtitle.zh: 任务、热深度、材料堆叠与量测结果共同决定方案
subtitle.en: Task, thermal depth, material stack and metrology results jointly determine the approach

body.zh: 最快或最高温的方案不一定最好；局部工艺最优也可能损害下游整合与可靠性。
body.en: The fastest or hottest approach is not necessarily best; a locally optimal process may harm downstream integration and reliability.

body.zh: 退火要实现什么？
body.en: What must the anneal accomplish?

body.zh: A. 激活/修复要求：扩散容限、晶格缺陷与目标 Rs
body.en: A. Activation / repair Requirements: diffusion tolerance, lattice defects And target Rs

body.zh: B. 相形成/硅化物要求：相组成、接触电阻与团聚窗口
body.en: B. Phase formation / silicides Requirements: phase composition, contact resistance And agglomeration window

body.zh: C. 致密化/应力要求：膜密度、收缩与机械应力
body.en: C. Densification / stress Requirements: film density, shrinkage And mechanical stress

body.zh: D. 界面钝化要求：Dit、漏电、材料与气氛兼容
body.en: D. Interface passivation Requirements: Dit, leakage, materials And ambient compatibility

body.zh: 允许总热预算？
body.en: Permissible total thermal budget?

body.zh: 需要全厚度还是表层/局部加热？
body.en: Is full-depth, surface or local heating required?

body.zh: 膜堆叠是否对光学吸收敏感？
body.en: Is the film stack sensitive to optical absorption?

body.zh: 材料可承受什么气氛？
body.en: What ambient can the material tolerate?

body.zh: 兼容/ 不兼容
body.en: Compatible / incompatible

body.zh: 候选热源（非唯一选项）
body.en: Candidate heat sources (not exclusive choices)

body.zh: 炉管退火（Furnace）
body.en: Furnace annealing (Furnace)

body.zh: RTP Soak（常规快速热退火）
body.en: RTP Soak (conventional rapid thermal annealing)

body.zh: Spike（短时高温）
body.en: Spike (short high-temperature exposure)

body.zh: Flash（极短脉冲）
body.en: Flash (ultrashort pulse)

body.zh: Laser（激光局部）
body.en: Laser (local laser heating)

body.zh: 组合流程（例如：预退火+SpikeRTA + Laser …）
body.en: Combined flow (e.g. pre-anneal + Spike, RTA + Laser …)

body.zh: 必须进行 Split 与DOE，以验证多种组合对目标与整合的影响；数据驱动选择，而非直觉。
body.en: Split and DOE are required to validate how combinations affect targets and integration; select using data rather than intuition.

body.zh: 七步闭环流程
body.en: Seven-step closed-loop Flow

body.zh: 明确目标指标• 器件/电学• 结构/界面• 工艺 /整合
body.en: Define target metrics • Device / electrical • Structure / interface • Process / integration

body.zh: 列出热预算与材料限制• 总热预算• 堆叠/厚度• 材料/气氛边界
body.en: List the thermal budget and Material constraints • Total thermal budget • Stack / thickness • Material / ambient boundaries

body.zh: 选择热源/轨迹/气氛• 热源与脉冲特征• 温度轨迹（相对）• 气氛与工艺顺序
body.en: Select the heat source / Trajectory / ambient • Heat-source and pulse characteristics • Temperature trajectory (relative) • Ambient and process sequence

body.zh: Split 与 DOE• 因子/水准设定•Split/阻断设计• 数据记录
body.en: Split and DOE • Factor / level settings • Split / blocking design • Data recording

body.zh: Inline 量测• 关键指标监控• 趋势/漂移•异常预警
body.en: Inline metrology • Monitor key metrics • Trends / drift • Early warning of anomalies

body.zh: WAT/可靠性反馈• 结构/电学验证• 应力/缺陷• 可靠性测试
body.en: WAT / Reliability feedback • Structural / electrical validation • Stress / defects • Reliability testing

body.zh: SPC 维持与异常处置• 控制图监控• 异常处置流程• 经验沉淀
body.en: SPC maintenance and Exception handling • Control-chart monitoring • Exception-handling procedure • Accumulated experience

body.zh: 闭环回流：反馈驱动迭代，可回到步骤2或3优化方案
body.en: Closed-loop return: feedback drives iteration; return to step 2 or 3 to optimize the approach

body.zh: 四张关键控制卡
body.en: Four key Control cards

body.zh: 激活率与结深□ 回片Rs / Hall□ 掺杂活化率□ 结深/侧向扩散□ 缺陷密度
body.en: Activation rate and junction depth □ Returned-wafer Rs / Hall □ Dopant activation fraction □ Junction depth / lateral diffusion □ Defect density

body.zh: 相组成与应力□ 相组成（比例/纯度）□ 接触电阻/比接触电阻□ 团聚/粒径分布□ 薄膜应力/弯曲
body.en: Phase composition and stress □ Phase composition (fraction / purity) □ Contact resistance / specific contact resistance □ Agglomeration / grain-size distribution □ Film stress / bending

body.zh: 片内/片间均匀性□ Wafer内均匀性□ Wafer间一致性□ 批间漂移趋势□ 边缘/中心差异
body.en: Within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer uniformity □ Within-wafer uniformity □ Wafer-to-wafer consistency □ Lot-to-lot drift trend □ Edge / center differences

body.zh: 缺陷与界面电学□ 缺陷类型/密度□ Dit/界面态□ 漏电/击穿特性□ 介质完整性
body.en: Defects and interface electrical characteristics □ Defect type / density □ Dit / interface states □ Leakage / breakdown behavior □ Dielectric integrity

body.zh: 耦合权衡（没有免费午餐）
body.en: Coupled tradeoffs (no free lunch)

body.zh: 低Rs可能伴随扩散或漏电
body.en: Low Rs May accompany diffusion or leakage

body.zh: 反应充分，可能伴随团聚或应力
body.en: Complete reaction may accompany agglomeration or stress

body.zh: 更低Dit，仍需验证材料与长期稳定性
body.en: Lower Dit still requires validation of material and long-term stability

body.zh: 常见风险（先识别，后决策）
body.en: Common risks (identify before deciding)

body.zh: 只看单一指标，忽略多项耦合
body.en: Focusing on one metric and overlooking multiple couplings

body.zh: 温度校准偏差，导致判定失真
body.en: Temperature-calibration bias distorts judgment

body.zh: 腔体/光学不匹配，结果不可迁移
body.en: Chamber / optical mismatch prevents transferring results

body.zh: 边缘异常未识别，造成大面积风险
body.en: Unrecognized edge anomalies create large-area risk

body.zh: 抽样不足，统计意义不足
body.en: Insufficient sampling and statistical significance

body.zh: 异常处置原则
body.en: Exception-handling principles

body.zh: 排查设备 / 材料/环境因素
body.en: Investigate equipment / materials / environmental factors

body.zh: 评估风险并决定是否触发工程变更
body.en: Assess risk and decide whether to trigger an engineering change

body.zh: 记录处置与再验证结果
body.en: Record corrective actions and revalidation results

body.zh: 量测反馈矩阵
body.en: Metrology feedback Matrix

body.zh: Rs / Hall判断对象：激活程度、载流子浓度迁移率、片内均匀性
body.en: Rs / Hall Assesses: Activation, carrier concentration, Mobility and within-wafer uniformity

body.zh: SIMS / SRP判断对象：掺杂浓度分布、结深、侧向扩散
body.en: SIMS / SRP Assesses: Dopant concentration distribution, Junction depth and lateral diffusion

body.zh: TEM / XRD / Raman判断对象：晶相组成、晶粒尺寸、缺陷与应力
body.en: TEM / XRD / Raman Assesses: Crystal-phase composition, grain size, Defects and stress

body.zh: C-V/I-V判断对象：界面态（Dit）、漏电、击穿与钝化效果
body.en: C–V / I–V Assesses: Interface states (Dit), leakage, Breakdown and passivation results

body.zh: WAT / 可靠性判断对象：器件性能分布、寿命、漂移与稳定性
body.en: WAT / reliability Assesses: Device-performance distribution, lifetime, Drift and stability

body.zh: 下游影响
body.en: Downstream effects

body.zh: 性能分布影响时序、驱动、噪声、能效与功能窗
body.en: Performance distribution Affects timing, drive, noise, Energy efficiency and functional windows

body.zh: 接触良率影响硅化物/接触电阻、导通损耗与可靠性
body.en: Contact yield Affects silicidation / contact resistance, Conduction loss and reliability

body.zh: 漏电影响静态功耗、发热、可靠性与寿命
body.en: Leakage Affects static power, heat, Reliability and lifetime

body.zh: 可靠性影响 TDDB、NBTI、HTRB等失效率/寿命
body.en: Reliability Affects TDDB, NBTI, HTRB and other failure rates / lifetimes

body.zh: 剩余热预算影响后续工艺选择、材料稳定性与整合空间
body.en: Remaining thermal budget Affects subsequent process choices, Material stability and integration flexibility

body.zh: 量产流程可能采用预退火+Spike、RTA + Laser等组合；不能假设整片晶圆只能选择一种退火方法。
body.en: Production flows may combine pre-anneal + Spike or RTA + Laser; do not assume that an entire wafer must use only one annealing method.

body.zh: 确认量测有效性与校准状态
body.en: Confirm metrology validity and calibration status

body.en: No

body.en: No
